description: UI scaffolding (all feature pages and widgets), routing wiring, and Android permissions. Fills in app_router.dart (HomeRoute, PostRoute, CartRoute, LocationPickerRoute), GridPage, ProductPage and its sub-widgets, CartSheet, LocationPickerSheet, SearchBarWidget, and CartItemTile. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Update lib/routing/app_router.dart: add final class HomeRoute extends AppRoute { const HomeRoute(); } final class PostRoute extends AppRoute { const PostRoute({required this.postUrl}); final String postUrl; @override List<Object?> get props => [postUrl]; } final class CartRoute extends AppRoute { const CartRoute(); } final class LocationPickerRoute extends AppRoute { const LocationPickerRoute(); } Then fill: initial: const HomeRoute(), builder: (context, route) => switch (route) { HomeRoute() => const GridPage(), PostRoute(:final postUrl) => ProductPage(postUrl: postUrl), CartRoute() => const CartPage(), LocationPickerRoute() => const LocationPickerPage(), }. CartPage and LocationPickerPage can be thin wrappers over the sheet widgets presented as full pages (Scaffold + CartSheet / LocationPickerSheet content inline) for the router, or dedicated page widgets — choose dedicated page widgets for cleaner nav stack.

Create lib/features/search/search_bar_widget.dart. StatefulWidget SearchBarWidget with onSearch(List<String> keywords, List<String> labels) callback. Internal TextEditingController for keyword input. Chip list for active labels. The | separator in the search text is parsed into multiple labels on submit (split by '|' and trim; prefix 'label:' terms are extracted as labels too). Submit calls onSearch. A chips row shows active labels with delete X. Style consistent with the app's dark/cyan theme.

Create lib/features/grid/grid_card.dart. GridCard(schema Map<String,dynamic>) StatelessWidget. Uses CachedNetworkImage for the image (SchemaExtractor.extractImage(schema)). Shows name, price with currency, stock badge (green 'In Stock' / red 'Out of Stock' based on SchemaExtractor.extractStockLevel), and areaServed chip (first area name). onTap navigates via appRouterConfig.router.push(PostRoute(postUrl: schemaUrl)) where schemaUrl comes from schema['url'] or schema['@id'].

Create lib/features/grid/grid_page.dart. GridPage StatefulWidget (or SignalStatefulWidget). Instantiates GridBloc and LocationBloc locally (not via provider — direct instantiation is fine for simple cases; use BlocSignalProvider if child widgets need it). AppBar with SearchBarWidget. Location chip in AppBar actions showing current city or 'Set Location' — taps push LocationPickerRoute. GridView.builder 2-column with GridCard. Scroll listener at bottom triggers bloc.loadMore(). On init calls bloc.loadFeed(). SignalBuilder wrapping GridView to rebuild on bloc state changes.
Create lib/features/product/widgets/stock_badge.dart. StockBadge(String? availability) — green Chip 'In Stock' if availability contains 'InStock', red 'Out of Stock' otherwise.
Create lib/features/product/widgets/image_carousel.dart. ImageCarousel(List<String> imageUrls) — PageView.builder with CachedNetworkImage, dots indicator below.

Create lib/features/product/widgets/variant_selector.dart. VariantSelector({List<Map<String,dynamic>> variants, Map<String,dynamic>? selected, void Function(Map<String,dynamic>) onSelect}) — Wrap of Chip widgets, selected variant highlighted with cyan border.

Create lib/features/product/widgets/addon_section.dart. AddonSection({List<Map<String,dynamic>> addons, Set<String> selectedNames, void Function(String name, bool checked) onToggle}) — CheckboxListTile per addon showing name and price.

Create lib/features/product/widgets/seller_card.dart. SellerCard(Map<String,dynamic>? seller) — Card with seller name, phone (InkWell to launch url tel:), email (mailto:), address text. Null-safe, shows nothing if seller null.
Create lib/features/product/widgets/specs_section.dart. SpecsSection(List<Map<String,dynamic>> properties) — DataTable or simple key-value Column with name and value from additionalProperty list.

Create lib/features/product/product_page.dart. ProductPage(String postUrl) StatefulWidget. Instantiates ProductBloc, CartRepository, WishlistRepository. On init: parse postId from postUrl (last path segment or query param; fallback: pass entire url as pseudo-id and let fetchPost handle it — actually BloggerDataService.fetchPost takes postId not url; need to extract postId from the URL or pass the full URL for http.get fetch path in resolveAndLoadSchema. Decision: PostRoute carries postUrl which is the blog post alternate URL. ProductBloc.loadPost accepts either a postId (for Blogger API v1 feed) or a full URL. Add loadPostFromUrl(String url) to ProductBloc that does an http GET on the URL, extracts JSON-LD directly via extractJsonLd, then resolveAndLoadSchema). Uses SignalBuilder on bloc.state. Shows ImageCarousel, name (Text headline), description (Text body), price, StockBadge, VariantSelector, AddonSection, SellerCard, SpecsSection, qty stepper Row (IconButton minus, Text, IconButton plus), Row of two ElevatedButtons: 'Add to Cart' and 'Add to Wishlist' (icon bookmark). AppBar with back button.

Create lib/features/cart/cart_item_tile.dart. CartItemTile(OrderItem item, CartBloc bloc) — ListTile with imageUrl thumbnail (CachedNetworkImage), name, price, qty stepper (minus/plus IconButtons calling bloc.updateQty), trailing delete IconButton calling bloc.removeItem.

Create lib/features/cart/cart_sheet.dart. CartSheet StatelessWidget (used both as sheet and as page content). Shows ListView of CartItemTile widgets. Bottom bar: total price Text + 'Checkout' ElevatedButton (stub: shows SnackBar 'Coming soon: Google Pay / Apple Pay'). 'Clear Cart' TextButton. Wraps CartBloc via BlocSignalProvider or passed-in reference.
Create lib/features/cart/cart_page.dart (thin Scaffold wrapper). CartPage: Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Cart')), body: CartSheet()).

Create lib/features/location/location_picker_sheet.dart. LocationPickerSheet StatefulWidget. TextField with search, onChanged triggers service.searchLocation(query) after 400ms debounce. GPS button calls bloc.requestGps(). Results ListView with LocationData tiles — tap calls bloc.setManual(loc) then pops the route. Shows current saved location at top if present.
Create lib/features/location/location_picker_page.dart (thin Scaffold). LocationPickerPage: Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Choose Location')), body: LocationPickerSheet()).
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze exits 0 after all files are created
flutter build apk --debug succeeds (compiles to APK without error)
appRouterConfig compiles: initial: const HomeRoute(), switch covers all 4 route cases exhaustively
AndroidManifest.xml contains INTERNET, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permissions
findings: ProductPage receives a postUrl (alternate URL like https://www.bholix.com/2024/06/slug.html), not a raw postId. Add loadPostFromUrl(String url) to ProductBloc: GET the URL, extractJsonLd from HTML body, then resolveAndLoadSchema. The postId for the Blogger API path can still be used if the schema's @id contains a blogId/postId pair — the resolve step handles that automatically.
